article.title: Tema y rema
article.part: Referencia, información y foco — Referência, informação e foco
article.chapter: Estructura informativa, tópico y foco — Estrutura informacional, tópico e foco

claims.sectionKey: Tema y rema describen una manera de organizar la información de una oración
claims.summary: Tema and rema describe a method of organizing information in a sentence. Roughly, the topic is the starting point of discourse and the rema adds what is said about that point.

claims.sectionKey: En Esse livro, eu já li
claims.summary: In the example 'Esse livro, eu já li', 'esse livro' establishes the point of discourse and the rest adds information.
The topic often relates to accessible information or the subject the speaker wants to establish. The rema develops or updates that topic.

claims.sectionKey: Diferentes teorías lingüísticas usan tema/rema, tópico/comentario y dado/nuevo con definiciones parcialmente distintas
claims.summary: Different linguistic theories use theme/rema, topic/comment and datum/new with partially distinct definitions.

links.notes: The article states 'De forma aproximada, el tema es el punto de partida discursivo y el rema aporta lo que se dice sobre ese punto.' which directly matches the description in the source.
The source provides the example 'Esse livro, eu já li' which illustrates the concept of a topic establishing the main point and the rema adding additional information.

The article explains 'El tema suele relacionarse con información ya accesible o con el asunto que el hablante quiere establecer. El rema desarrolla o actualiza ese tema.' which aligns with the explanation in the source.
